scenarios.name: test-noncombat-damage
scenarios.why: Generated by lab/cmd/xmageport from XMage ShieldCounterTest#testNoncombatDamage.
scenarios.known_bug: XP[shield-counter-unimplemented]: Shield counters have no rules reader (only engine/effects/counters.go:633 names SHIELD) (see ShieldCounterTest#testCombatDamage; engine/rules/replacement_damage.go never consults SHIELD), so Lightning Bolt kills Disciplined Duelist instead of removing its shield counter. CR 122.1c.

scenarios.name: test-combat-damage
scenarios.why: Generated by lab/cmd/xmageport from XMage ShieldCounterTest#testCombatDamage.
scenarios.known_bug: XP[shield-counter-unimplemented]: Shield counters (CR 122.1c) have no rules reader: no replacement in engine/rules/replacement_damage.go or engine/rules/sba.go removes a shield counter instead of damage/destruction (grep SHIELD finds only engine/effects/counters.go:633 CounterType docs), so Disciplined Duelist dies to combat damage despite its counter (setup probe: SHIELD counter present). CR 122.1c.

scenarios.name: test-destroy-effect
scenarios.why: Generated by lab/cmd/xmageport from XMage ShieldCounterTest#testDestroyEffect.
scenarios.known_bug: XP[shield-counter-unimplemented]: Shield counters have no rules reader (only engine/effects/counters.go:633 names SHIELD) (see ShieldCounterTest#testCombatDamage; no destroy replacement in engine/rules/replacement.go), so Murder destroys Disciplined Duelist instead of removing its shield counter. CR 122.1c.
